about_the_game:
Overview

In a world shaped by Gods and Titans, the elemental forces that once held balance have begun to unravel. Long ago, divine power was shattered across the stars, giving birth to the creatures now known as Elestrals. As darkness stirs and conflict brews among the realms, the Gods call upon new Champions to rise. Will you protect the world… or reshape its destiny?

Elestrals Awakened is epic 2.5D single-player action-adventure, monster tamer RPG video game that puts you at the center of the Elestrals Universe.

Born from the smash-hit trading card game, Elestrals Awakened brings the rich lore, elemental forces, and epic adventures into a fully realized interactive world. Step into the role of a Caster, forge a bond with a Spirit companion, and explore the elemental lands as tensions rise and ancient powers awaken!

Gameplay

Choose Your Starter!

Eons ago, eight elemental spirits shaped the balance of the world. Earth, Fire, Water, Thunder, Wind, Frost, Solar, and Lunar. Each one embodies a force of nature, guiding those who align with its essence.

Now, as your journey begins, you must choose one of these elements and forge a sacred bond with its spirit. The element you choose will empower your abilities and mark your path as a Caster, shaping the way you clash, grow, and connect with the world around you.

Teratlas, the Earth Spirit values patience and growth. Sproutyr embodies this spirit, ascending into Centaurbor, a steadfast protector who believes strength is rooted in nurturing bonds and growing together.

Vipyro, the Fire Spirit burns with passion and loyalty. Necruff embodies this fierce devotion, ascending into the unstoppable guardian Trifernal, whose multiple heads watch over allies with unwavering determination. For Necruff, friendship is a flame that never dies!

Leviaphin, the Water Spirit flows with adaptability and calm. Sluggle embodies this laid-back nature, riding life's currents until ascending into Majesea, a serene yet formidable force beneath the waves. Sometimes the deepest waters run strongest!

Zaptor, the Thunder Spirit crackles with endless energy and excitement. Quackle embodies this electrifying spirit, playfully sparking chaos before ascending into Ohmperial, a majestic warrior whose elegance strikes like lightning. When opportunity calls, Quackle answers with a shock!

Lycarus, the Wind Spirit drifts with deceptive strength and resilience. Hydrake embodies this determination, appearing gentle yet unshakable in battle before ascending into Penterror, the five-headed tempest that refuses to be blown away. True power doesn't need to shout!

Flurrmine, the Frost Spirit thrives through adaptation and resilience. Kryoling embodies this cool confidence, loafing around until trouble freezes over, then ascending into Kryoscorch, a fearsome dragon whose icy fury leaves opponents cold. Chill today, conquer tomorrow!

Luminape, the Solar Spirit radiates joy and warmth under the brightest skies. Sundile embodies this sunny disposition, lazily while charging its inner light before ascending into Chronodile, a radiant protector of rivers and lakes. Every dawn brings new strength to shine!

Owlune, the Lunar Spirit glides silently through moonlit skies with grace. Fawnlit embodies this quiet elegance, treading softly through shadows before ascending into Posthumoose, a proud and heartfelt creature of the night. In darkness, courage shines brightest!

Bonding with an Elestral

Explore the world, clash against powerful Elestrals, and form lasting bonds with them. To bond successfully, time your moves carefully, press the directional keys in sync with the stars to strengthen your connection!

Stellar Elestrals

In Elestrals Awakened, players can embark on an exciting journey to discover Stellars: rare, alternate-color versions of Elestrals that shine with celestial brilliance. 

Each Stellar isn’t just visually unique, they’re stronger than their standard counterparts, possessing an additional Spirit Core that grants them a second combat Trait, unlocking powerful new synergies and strategies.

Stellar Hunting Methods:

  • Overworld Encounters: Stellars can appear naturally in the world for sharp-eyed adventurers to discover. These will have visual and audio queues.

  • Tall Grass Battles: Rare encounters while exploring the wilds.

  • Clash Chaining: Defeat an Elestral to instantly trigger another Clash, increasing your odds of finding a Stellar.

  • Chain Fishing: Cast your line and maintain a streak to uncover aquatic Stellars.

  • Nexus Discoveries: Use the Nexus mechanic to reveal hidden Stellars through elemental resonance.

Best of all, every Elestral in the game can be Stellar-hunted: no locks, no limits, just the thrill of discovery.

These Stellar Elestrals will be rare and rewarding and we can't wait to allow you to explore the brilliant world of Elestrals Awakened!

Game Modes

Once you finish the main story on any save file, you'll unlock special game modes. These modes will then be available for all new save files you create. You can play with just one mode active, or mix and match multiple modes together to customize your experience.

This mode restricts which Elestrals you can bond with, adding an extra layer of challenge. We are working on multiple toggleable versions of this mode, including the following:

  • Standard: You can only bond with the very first Elestral you clash with in each new area.

  • Mono Spirit: You can only bond with the first Elestral species you encounter in each new area that matches your starting Spirit Element.

When an Elestral's HP hits zero during a clash, they're gone for good. You won't be able to recover them during the clash or afterward, they can no longer be used for the rest of your journey.

This mode lets you shake things up with multiple options you can mix and match. 

  • Randomize enemy Caster teams.

  • Randomize which Elestrals appear in each area (pulling from the entire game).

  • Randomize learnsets and Spirit Cores.

Perfect for players who want to move fast and keep track. This mode will automatically start a timer the moment you start the game. Multiple checkpoints will also be included, giving you the ability to keep track of your pace as you progress through the game!

As you progress through your journey, an optional level cap will limit how strong your Elestrals can grow before each key clash. This ensures every major battle remains fair and challenging. Once you emerge victorious, the cap is raised, allowing your Elestrals to continue growing toward the next great test of strength.

The World

Many who wander the Foloi Forest lose their way amid its endless groves. At its heart rests the Elder Tree, where Demeter, Goddess of the Harvest, guards nature’s hidden paths.

Within the molten heart of a restless volcano burns the Volcanic Forge. Here, Hephaestus toils beside fiery Elestrals, his creations echoing his temper, brilliant, fierce, and prone to eruption.

Beneath the boundless sea rests Atlantis, the sunken realm of Poseidon. With his loyal Elestrals, he guards the deep and breathes new life into the coral ruins of his forgotten city.

Reach the towering peaks of Mt. Olympus, the highest mountain in the realm. At its summit awaits the Temple of Zeus, where only the worthy may prove their strength before the God of Thunder.

Suspended among the clouds, the Island of Aeolia drifts above the world after the Titan war. Here, Aeolus moves with the ever-shifting winds, gathering currents and breezes, ready to test any who approach.

Bathed in the glow of the world’s brightest auroras, the Mountains of Boreas stretch endlessly into the sky. Hidden within are paths to unfathomed depths uncharted and forbidden, watched by divine decree, where no traveler has returned.

Illuminated by golden light, the Temple of the Sun rests amid fruit-laden trees and tranquil waters. Its serene gardens and radiant landscapes offer peace, drawing all who seek quiet reflection beneath the warmth of the divine sun.

Hidden beyond the Sinyster Forest and the Crater of Creation, the Temple of the Moon flourishes under the glow of a full moon. Its lush gardens awaken at night, drawing Elestrals who revel in the moonlit hours.

Descend the seemingly endless paths of Clash Canyon, where every step tests your strength. With each turn, foes grow more formidable, and only those who endure to the end can claim triumph.

The Coliseum stands as the sacred arena where casters prove their might before the Divines. Only the most Elite Casters are granted entry, their battles echoing through hallowed halls as a testament to skill and honor.

Music & Audio

No AI is used for any of our art or creative assets!
